facts.text: Carlos が2014年に公開し、外部出資に頼らず始めたと会社は説明している。
最初の公開前に約1か月、夜間に開発したと振り返っている。
公開時は資源の限られた4人のチームだったと振り返っている。
2014年5月14日に Hacker News へ Stripe 向け請求書サービスとして投稿された。
投稿はトップページに8時間掲載されたと本人は報告している。
投稿の2週間後の集計は訪問410人、登録19人、Stripe 接続5人、有料客2人だったと報告している。
この掲載から有料客2人、月次継続売上100ドルを得たと報告している。
見込客 jot は3社分を契約したかったが、Stripe の取引に必要な情報を加えるにはコードを書く必要があることや、Stripe 接続が設定の5番目の手順であることなどが障害だったと投稿した。
創業者は同日、Stripe 接続を登録手順の最初に移したと返答した。
5月19日の返答では、追加情報の設定なしでも Stripe の支払から付加価値税を算出できるようにしたと報告した。
顧客データを第三者へ渡す不安と自前設置版の要望が出たが、創業者は当時その版を開発する予定はないと返答した。
当時の投稿者は月24ドルと48ドルの料金に言及している。
オンライン販売者向けに販売地別の税額算出、請求書、税登録のしきい値通知、申告支援を提供する。
公式トップは利用事業者2,300超と表示する。
公式トップは Quaderno を通じて処理された売上が140億ドル超と表示する。
150超の国を支援すると表示する。
月額は Hobby 29、Startup 49、Business 99、Growth 149。料金表はユーロとドルを併記している。
月の取引上限は順に25、250、1,000、2,500件。連携の呼出し上限は取引上限の10倍。
取引件数には請求書・領収書・貸方票・経費が含まれる。販売件数だけを数える料金ではない。
Hobby は1利用者・1税管轄・1連携。他の料金段階ではそれらを制限しない。
単月の超過は1取引25セントで対応でき、2か月連続で超過すると自動で上位料金へ移ると記載されている。
稼働水準の特別契約は月10,000取引以上の料金段階からと記載する。
料金ページはカード不要の7日間の試用と、最初の設定の個別相談を案内している。
料金ページは、上限を超えると次の料金段階へ自動で変更されると説明している。
紹介した有料客の支払から30％を最長24か月支払うと案内する。申込は人が審査する。
紹介報酬の支払は四半期ごと、最低100ドルと有効な紹介先3件が条件。
PayPal または Wise で報酬を支払う。自己紹介は禁止し、追跡には閲覧者の Cookie 許可が必要とする。
紹介制度のヘルプは最低支払額50ドル、支払は1月・4月・7月・10月の最初の週と記載する。
利用規約は提供主体を Recrea Systems, SL と記載する。
規約は月の料金を前払い・返金なしとし、月途中の解約でもその月の全額が必要と記載する。
規約は随時解約と無料のデータ取出しを認め、請求書・顧客・商品などを構造化データで取得できると記載する。
解約後の削除時期は第5節が6か月、第6節が30日の取出し期間後と記載し、同一規約内で食い違う。
規約は第三者サービスとして Zamp Technologies, Inc. と Global VAT Compliance B.V. の条件を参照する。

About Quaderno
Our purpose
Our mission is to empower online sellers to maintain compliance with indirect tax regulations globally, ensuring seamless and accurate tax management across all jurisdictions.
Our goal is simple. You should spend more time growing your business and building meaningful products, and less time worrying about tax rules, filings, and compliance updates.
Our product
Quaderno is tax compliance software that automates sales tax, VAT , and GST for SaaS , e-commerce, and digital businesses. We help online businesses navigate international regulations without the headache of manual workflows.
With Quaderno, online business owners can:
Automate tax calculations
Calculate the correct tax in real-time based on your customer’s precise location.
Handle Sales Tax, VAT, and GST compliance
Collect and store mandatory location evidence automatically for every sale.
Validate B2B VAT numbers instantly to handle tax-exempt sales correctly.
Simplify tax reporting, threshold monitoring, and filing
Generate instant, jurisdiction-specific reports that make filing a seamless task.
Track your sales volume in every region and receive alerts before you hit tax registration thresholds.
Have tax registration and filing tasks done on your behalf - Quaderno takes care of it all.
Streamline global digital tax management
Send automated, compliant invoices in your customer’s local language and currency.
Sync your sales data seamlessly across Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, and even accounting tools like Xero.
Who we serve
Quaderno is built for online-first businesses, including:
SaaS companies
E-commerce businesses
Digital service providers
Subscription platforms
We primarily support companies that sell across borders and need a simple, reliable way to manage tax compliance in multiple countries and regions.
Our story
Quaderno launched in 2014 by our founder Carlos, who bootstrapped for 10 years. We built with focus and discipline, growing carefully and keeping operations lean while improving our product and supporting customers around the world.
In 2023, we joined the Visma family, one of Europe’s leading providers of mission-critical business software. This partnership strengthened our infrastructure, security, and product capabilities while allowing us to continue operating with independence and long term vision, and of course, offering the best to our clients.
Today, we combine startup agility with enterprise stability to deliver reliable tax automation for growing businesses. Our team (and many of our customers) have been with us since 2014, a reflection of the long-term relationships we’ve built along the way.
Origin of our name
In 1494, Luca Pacioli laid the foundations of modern accounting in a book in which, among many other interesting topics, he explained the accounting techniques of his time. He also described the quaderno , the main ledger that contained a merchant’s complete accounting records.
That historical ledger inspired our name.
Six centuries later, we carry that tradition forward by improving tax management with a simple and powerful automation platform. We believe you should spend more time doing meaningful work and less time worrying about taxes.

Remote first and async
The Quaderno tax team works remotely from Spain, Italy, the UK , and the US . We believe you must live in the place that makes you happiest.
We work 5 hour days and we’re profitable. No toxic meetings, no endless phone calls, no nonsense. Just focused work. The rest of the day is dedicated to family, friends, pets, and hobbies, and personal growth (you know, the important stuff).
If you would like to visit or simply say hello, feel free to reach out to us at any time with questions, feedback, or just a friendly message.
Our brand
As our product evolved to meet the changing needs of our customers, our brand evolved as well.

Is Hacker News A Good Platform To Launch Your Product?
Posted by Carlos
• Created on May 8, 2023
• Updated on Feb 2, 2025
In this article
Good and Bad Experiences
The Facts
Submit your product to HN should not be the only core-step of your launch
Two weeks ago we decided to “officially” launch our little new product, a Stripe add-on on steroids to generate invoices . About time!
After one month of night coding, pizza eating, surfing, and much more coding, we were looking forward getting the first reactions from outsiders.
Specially Hacker News , among other sites, was definitely one of the places where we wanted to showcase what we had been building. HN has been the virtual place where we have read great insights and shared feedback about others’ projects. Now it was our turn.
Good and Bad Experiences
“Why HN?”, you may be wondering. “Is not a place full of negative wannabes ?”
So far, our experience has not been that bad. It’s true that when people can hide themselves behind a nickname, they tend to be more critic with your thing. But those are the less cases.
For a long time, HN has been the place to be, the place where all the startups want to make their mise en scène , with the hope of getting thousands of signups and paying customers.
I know. It’s so naïve… But people still think that way.
However, we have to asume the reality, a reality that can be cruel sometimes. The fact that HN audience might be interested in what you have built does not make intrinsically that they are ‘your targeted audience’. At least not in most of the cases. In fact, most of the showcased projects get almost nothing. Nada.
HN is a forum, a place to share and discuss links to content that may be interesting to the community, a developers/makers-community. Not a signups machine.
Basecamp received 105,000 visits from HN one month before launching their last version. They got 97 signups (0,09%) and 14 paying customers (0,01%). Yeah!
The guys from Groove stated they received 33,198 visits after one of their posts was published on HN . They got 96 signups (0,29%) and 12 paying customers (0,04%). We’re improving!
It’s not so bad to get 12 or 14 paying customers for free, but these conversion rates are not as high as you expected, right?
There’re also some counterexamples. Josh Pigford got $1,500 in MRR after one of his articles was posted on HN.
I like his explanation about it:
It’s not that Hacker News doesn’t have any legitimate business owners that can convert to paying customers, it’s that most of the content that gets posted there targets the wrong people…the “early stage startups” and “wantrepreneurs” with no money who argue about inconsequential things while the real business owners are out building real businesses. Josh Pigford. “So, why did you want to appear on HN?”
Because we wanted to make a little market research. That’s all. We thought HN was a perfect place to pose this question:
Are people out there interested in an invoice generator for Stripe? And HN is a good place to ask the community and get their feedback.
The Facts
On May 14th we posted the next post: " Show HN: Quaderno.io - Billing for Stripe ". The post was on the homepage for 8 hours , and received 69 votes and 42 comments.
These were our metrics two weeks later:
410 visitors
19 signups (5.26%)
5 qualified leads (1.22%)
2 customers (0.49%)
Invaluable feedback from our targeted potential users
FYI, for us a qualified lead is someone who has connected his Stripe account with Quaderno.io.
2 customers and $100 MRR. Not so bad for a free post. But the best part was the feedback we got. Definitely.
Those 42 comments were pure gold .
We exhibited our small project in front of people that we were looking for a solution like this. And in return we obtained feedback on:
the concept ,
our onboarding process ,
the VAT feature , that took as to create a proper landing page to disclose more in detail something that was not that obvious in our main landing.
Thank you to all the people whom gave us their feedback!
We are a 4-people startup with limited resources (development time, marketing budget) so it was a key element for us to know if we were building something that could solve a real pain. Initial traction proofed us that we were not wrong. We know there is still tons of work to do, but we took the decision to keep on working on it.
Submit your product to HN should not be the only core-step of your launch
Think about it. You have 1 or 2 opportunities to get the attention among 600/700 links submitted per day – you can see easily all the links submitted for the last day if you enter ‘*’ into the search box + ‘Last 24 hours’ in the UI. That’s a 0.25% probabilities of being upvoted!
I’m trying to help here, not being negative just a bit realistic. I just want to point out that HN should be more like ‘another speaker’ that can take your launch to more people. For sure, you should consider other ways of getting attention to your product besides HN.
With that being said, if your product or idea is tech-oriented and you are willing to discuss your ideas, and having 1-1 feedback that might be not always as positive as you though, I really encourage you to submit it to HackerNews.
Have you ever published a project on HN? I’d like to know your experience.

if stripe_payment.metadata.tax.nil?

Quaderno affiliate program
Affiliates are a very important part of our growth strategy. You can join the Affiliate Program here .
Joining the Quaderno Affiliate Program
Use this link to sign up and our team will review your application and approve it manually if it seems to be a good fit.
If approved, you will receive an email with the affiliate dashboard link and your password. Once you sign in you can see all your stats, enter your PayPal payment information, and download any logos or assets you need.
Start promoting! You’ll see any clicks or activity reflected in your account.
Common Questions
What commission can I expect as an Affiliate?
As a Quaderno affiliate, you will earn a 30% commission each month for every paying customer you refer. That means if you send us an account worth €49/month, you’ll earn €14.70. Every month.
Do you offer special discounts for affiliate audiences?
At the moment, we don't offer special discounts for affiliate audiences. However, when we do promo campaigns, we always include our affiliates and allow them to extend the same offer to their audience (for example, Black Friday promo).
Do you have any promotion ideas?
Here are a few promotion ideas to get you started:
Write a review about Quaderno and publish that on your blog and send it out to your email list.
Add details about Quaderno, along with your affiliate link, to any pages or posts you have on how to create a business or handle receipts or taxes.
Partner with us for a webinar that you promote to your list and we will teach one hour of free content on taxes and accounting.
Add Quaderno to your Resources page on your blog as your recommended accounting tool.
Anything else you can think of!
When payouts are made?
Payouts are currently made the first week of January, April, July, and October.
Is there a minimum for the payouts
You need to earn $50 minimum before being paid out.
Troubleshooting
I completed the form and clicked on "I accept terms" but it reloads the page before I click on "Sign up".
When you click on "I agree to affiliate terms", another tab opens where you can see exactly the same info (the affiliate terms & conditions). You need to first scroll down then you will be able to go back and click the box, so you can sign-up

facts.text: Carlos が2014年に公開し、外部出資に頼らず始めたと会社は説明している。
最初の公開前に約1か月、夜間に開発したと振り返っている。
公開時は資源の限られた4人のチームだったと振り返っている。
2014年5月14日に Hacker News へ Stripe 向け請求書サービスとして投稿された。
投稿はトップページに8時間掲載されたと本人は報告している。
投稿の2週間後の集計は訪問410人、登録19人、Stripe 接続5人、有料客2人だったと報告している。
この掲載から有料客2人、月次継続売上100ドルを得たと報告している。
見込客 jot は3社分を契約したかったが、Stripe の取引に必要な情報を加えるにはコードを書く必要があることや、Stripe 接続が設定の5番目の手順であることなどが障害だったと投稿した。
創業者は同日、Stripe 接続を登録手順の最初に移したと返答した。
5月19日の返答では、追加情報の設定なしでも Stripe の支払から付加価値税を算出できるようにしたと報告した。
顧客データを第三者へ渡す不安と自前設置版の要望が出たが、創業者は当時その版を開発する予定はないと返答した。
当時の投稿者は月24ドルと48ドルの料金に言及している。
オンライン販売者向けに販売地別の税額算出、請求書、税登録のしきい値通知、申告支援を提供する。
公式トップは利用事業者2,300超と表示する。
公式トップは Quaderno を通じて処理された売上が140億ドル超と表示する。
150超の国を支援すると表示する。
月額は Hobby 29、Startup 49、Business 99、Growth 149。料金表はユーロとドルを併記している。
月の取引上限は順に25、250、1,000、2,500件。連携の呼出し上限は取引上限の10倍。
取引件数には請求書・領収書・貸方票・経費が含まれる。販売件数だけを数える料金ではない。
Hobby は1利用者・1税管轄・1連携。他の料金段階ではそれらを制限しない。
単月の超過は1取引25セントで対応でき、2か月連続で超過すると自動で上位料金へ移ると記載されている。
稼働水準の特別契約は月10,000取引以上の料金段階からと記載する。
料金ページはカード不要の7日間の試用と、最初の設定の個別相談を案内している。
料金ページは、上限を超えると次の料金段階へ自動で変更されると説明している。
紹介した有料客の支払から30％を最長24か月支払うと案内する。申込は人が審査する。
紹介報酬の支払は四半期ごと、最低100ドルと有効な紹介先3件が条件。
PayPal または Wise で報酬を支払う。自己紹介は禁止し、追跡には閲覧者の Cookie 許可が必要とする。
紹介制度のヘルプは最低支払額50ドル、支払は1月・4月・7月・10月の最初の週と記載する。
利用規約は提供主体を Recrea Systems, SL と記載する。
規約は月の料金を前払い・返金なしとし、月途中の解約でもその月の全額が必要と記載する。
規約は随時解約と無料のデータ取出しを認め、請求書・顧客・商品などを構造化データで取得できると記載する。
解約後の削除時期は第5節が6か月、第6節が30日の取出し期間後と記載し、同一規約内で食い違う。
規約は第三者サービスとして Zamp Technologies, Inc. と Global VAT Compliance B.V. の条件を参照する。
